entries.title: Solar System - Basic scene and AI-enhanced poster derivative
entries.creator: Caner Sevince; derivative enhanced with OpenAI image generation
entries.requiredCreditText: Solar System - Basic by Caner Sevince, sourced from the Spline Community under CC0 1.0; poster derivative enhanced with OpenAI image generation.
entries.aiAssistanceDisclosure: Detail restoration and enhancement performed with OpenAI image generation.
transformations: Enhanced the 1304 × 820 Spline Community preview with OpenAI image generation to restore detail while preserving the centered Solar System composition; generated intermediate checksum sha256:4abce3bd1bfd61c0b2800ae254f804276670f1fa762edc9b17b3f05ea21f8ede.
Resampled the 1582 × 994 enhanced PNG to 3200 × 1906 with ImageMagick Lanczos filtering and a light unsharp pass.
Converted the 3200 × 1906 result to WebP with cwebp 1.6.0 at quality 92, method 6, with metadata removed.
notes: The Spline Community page identifies the original scene as Solar System - Basic by Caner Sevince and licenses it under CC0 1.0.
The live decorative scene loads after browser idle only when the hero is visible, WebGL is available, and reduced motion is not requested; the poster provides the initial and fallback render.
The visual is an interpretive presentation asset, not a scale model or canonical scientific data.

entries.title: Cute Alien Character
entries.creator: Ndevisuals
entries.sourceVersion: Fab listing and Blender source package reviewed 2026-08-13
entries.requiredCreditText: ‘Cute Alien Character’ by Ndevisuals, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Modified for Janus Observatory.
entries.aiAssistanceDisclosure: Fab marks the source asset as not generated with AI. OpenAI Codex assisted the project-specific Blender rig, animation staging, export pipeline, and integration code.
transformations: Imported the original Blender source into Blender 5.2, separated its mirrored sleeve, cuff, and hand components, added object-level controls to both shoulders and the near wrist, authored a four-second anticipate/lean/reach/focus/settle performance with pronounced body, blink, and antenna secondary motion, staged it against the admitted telescope, and exported the combined scene as binary glTF.
notes: Interpretive fictional visualization; it is not a Project Janus research artifact or a proposed real instrument design.
The original source package, editable Blender derivative, deterministic build script, and contact-sheet QA are retained under assets/sources/fab/ and docs/qa/.

allowedTransformations: incorporation into the Janus Observatory project
appliedTransformations: incorporation into the Janus Observatory project
transformations: Imported the original FBX and navy swatch texture into Blender 5.2, scaled and positioned the telescope to preserve tripod contact, aligned the eyepiece with the character, added named eyepiece/objective optical-axis locators for the browser camera handoff, and exported it inside the combined binary glTF scene.
